title: How do you focus stacking to photograph a ring?
h1: 📸 Focus stacking for a clear ring photo
metaTitle: 🔍 Focus stacking: perfect photo of a ring
description: 📷 Achieve a completely clear image of your jewelry thanks to automated focus stacking with Orbitvu. Steps, settings, tools.
tool: Obitvu Station software, a Canon EOS RP camera, and a 100mm Macro lens
logistics: Alphashot Micro V2 and someone on your team
introText:
🔍 Focus stacking, or focus stacking, is an essential technique in macro photography of products, particularly suitable for jewelry such as bracelets, rings or cufflinks.

This method allows Assemble automatically several photos taken at different focus distances to obtain a final image completely clear, from the foreground to the background.

💍With this tutorial, we show you how to make a Focus Stacking with the software Orbitvu Station, combined with the Orbitvu photo studio specialized in jewelry photography, Alphashot Micro V2.

steps.title: Positioning and choice of the template
steps.content:
🧼Start by cleaning your ring to avoid any imperfection.

📌 Position it correctly on the center point of the photo studio, or by using a mounting kit for an optimal result.

📂 Once your ring is in place, choose the Template predefined shooting in the software, corresponding to the type of jewelry you are capturing (simple, precious or complex ring).

Once your ring is in place, choose the shooting template predefined in the software, corresponding to the type of jewelry you are capturing (simple, precious or complex ring).

steps.title: Light and camera settings
steps.content:
💡 Ensure that the light conditions are optimal to capture the details of the ring without creating unwanted reflections.

📷 We recommend using a macro lens to maximize detail, with a large aperture (f/2.8 to f/4) to obtain a shallow depth of field and a beautiful sharpness of your jewelry.💍

⚡To make your image as clear as possible, we recommend that you adjust the value ISO between 100 and 200 In order To avoid noise.

⚖️La white balance should be adjusted according to your preference and your light environment.

Also adjust thelighting of the studio depending on the finish of the jewel (matt or shiny).

For more precision, check out our guide to camera settings for jewelry photography.

steps.title: Using Superfocus (Assistant)
steps.content:
Click on the Superfocus Wizard from the Orbitvu Station interface.💻

This assistant will guide automatically the different stages of stacking by suggesting the ideal parameters for focus stacking.
steps.structuredText: Click on the Superfocus Wizard from the Orbitvu Station interface. This assistant will automatically guide the various stacking steps by suggesting the ideal settings for focus stacking.

steps.title: 1st stacking stage - focus on the front area
steps.content:
🔍 Start the sequence by zooming in and focusing the first time on the front part of the ring, that is, the first plan.

This will allow you to enter all precise details of the areas closest to the objective.
steps.structuredText: Start the sequence by zooming in and focusing first on the front part of the ring, i.e. the foreground. This will allow you to capture all the precise details of the areas closest to the lens.

steps.title: 2nd stacking stage - focus on the back area
steps.content:
Move the focus gradually to rear part of the ring.

🔍 Zoom can be used here to make sure fine details, like carvings or stones, are captured accurately.
steps.structuredText: Move the focus gradually to the back of the ring. Zoom can be used here to make sure fine details, like carvings or stones, are captured accurately.

steps.title: 3rd stage of stacking - set the size of the steps between the focuses
steps.content:
Configure the Step size (or increments) between the different shots.

One small step size is recommended for rings that are complex or have fine details. This ensures that all areas of the object are perfectly clean.
steps.structuredText: Set the size of the steps (or increments) between shots. A small step size is recommended for rings that are complex or have fine details. This ensures that all areas of the object are perfectly clear.

steps.title: 4th stage of stacking - number of steps for focusing
steps.content:
Determine the number of steps to complete for full focus stacking. The number of steps required Depends on the opening of your objective and of the complexity of the object.💍

The larger the aperture, the shallower the depth of field, and the more you'll need intermediate photos to ensure perfect sharpness.

Click “Capture All” to start shooting.🎬

faqs.question: How to avoid unwanted reflections when shooting?
faqs.answer: To minimize reflections, adjust studio lighting sources to diffuse or direct them indirectly. The use of light diffusers and light settings that are customized according to the material of the jewelry is also recommended.

faqs.question: Why is built-in editing software essential for ring photography?
faqs.answer: Embedded software, like Orbitvu Station, makes it possible to quickly correct blemishes, adjust colors and light, and enhance details without requiring third-party software. This speeds up production and reduces post-production costs.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of using focus stacking compared to simple shooting?
faqs.answer: Focus stacking allows for maximum sharpness in all areas of the ring, which is essential for jewelry with complex details. Unlike simple shooting, it eliminates the problems associated with a reduced depth of field.

faqs.question: How does focus stacking reduce post-production costs?
faqs.answer: By capturing multiple images at different focus planes and automatically merging them together, focus stacking eliminates the need for extensive manual retouching. This reduces post-production costs and speeds up the visual creation process.

faqs.question: What financial benefits can you get from training in jewelry photography?
faqs.answer: By learning how to set up capture and lighting settings correctly, you reduce editing needs and capture errors. This makes it possible to increase productivity and to reduce production costs.
